body.p: Plugins or frameworks installed in Web Author can contain a folder named ai-positron-actions where custom AI actions are automatically loaded from by the AI Positron.
The ai-positron-actions folder can contain an extra file named excluded-action-ids.txt, which can list all action IDs (on a line-by-line basis) that should be filtered out of the AI Positron UI.

To know an action's ID, after you invoke an AI action you can press / in the chat input text area and choose to export the conversation to JSON. The JSON exported representation of the action should contain the action ID.
